extraction.outputs: Checks and bounded stdout are copied from the redacted source report. Native stderr is omitted. RPC results are represented by the original successful check receipts; no response body is invented.
extraction.paths: Original report placeholders <TEMP_ROOT>/<CLIENT_BIN>/<HOST_HOME> are retained. Entry digests identify only the recorded entry file; package integrity and lock digests remain separate.

isolation.homes: Independent temporary HOME/AW/Agent/XDG roots and project/neutral directories per scope.
isolation.clientInstallation: Exact public npm versions; installation scripts disabled; temporary prefixes removed.

qualificationBoundary.products: Only Grok CLI 1.0.77 User ordinary Skills in Linux x64/arm64, macOS arm64 and Windows x64. Project and unavailable client distributions are excluded.
qualificationBoundary.surface: Native installation, current-body discovery, refresh through uninstall --keep-data/install, neutral-directory discovery and removal from the AW projection candidate.
limitations: No prompts, model adoption or invocation-control qualification.
